references.text: The priest shall examine the rash and declare the person unclean if it proves to be leprosy
If the rash spreads in the skin, the priest shall declare the person unclean—it is leprosy
The priest shall examine on the seventh day, and if the rash has spread, he shall declare the person unclean
The person is leprous and unclean, and the priest shall declare him unclean because of the sore on the head
The priest shall examine the house, and if the rash has spread, it is malignant leprosy
Instructions to carefully follow the priests' guidance regarding leprosy
